skills.label: Automate work with scheduled tasks
skills.desc: Put Claude Code on autopilot. Create scheduled tasks, formerly routines, that run in the cloud on a schedule, on API calls, or on GitHub events.

skills.label: Get started with Claude Code in the cloud
skills.desc: Run Claude Code in the cloud from your browser or phone. Connect a GitHub repository, submit a task, and review the PR without local setup.

skills.label: Use Claude Code in the cloud
skills.desc: Run Claude Code sessions in the cloud from your browser, phone, Desktop app, or terminal, move them with --cloud and --teleport, and auto-fix pull requests.

skills.label: Claude Code Desktop in WSL
skills.desc: Run Code sessions inside a WSL 2 distribution on Windows

skills.label: Claude Desktop on Linux (beta)
skills.desc: Install and update the Claude desktop app on Ubuntu and Debian

skills.label: Desktop application
skills.desc: Get more out of Claude Code Desktop: parallel sessions with Git isolation, drag-and-drop pane layout, integrated terminal and file editor, side chats, computer use, Dispatch sessions from your phone, visual diff review, app previews, PR monitoring, connectors, and enterprise configuration.

skills.label: Get started with the desktop app
skills.desc: Install the Claude desktop app, open the Code tab, and start your first Claude Code session on a project folder on your computer.

skills.label: Schedule recurring tasks in Claude Code Desktop
skills.desc: Set up scheduled tasks in Claude Code Desktop to run Claude automatically on a recurring basis for daily code reviews, dependency audits, or morning briefings.

skills.label: Test iOS apps in the simulator
skills.desc: Claude Code Desktop opens your app in the iOS Simulator pane when Claude builds, runs, or checks it.

skills.label: Catch security issues as Claude writes code
skills.desc: Install the security-guidance plugin to have Claude review its own code changes for vulnerabilities and fix them in the same session.

skills.label: Claude Code with GitHub Enterprise Server
skills.desc: Connect Claude Code to your self-hosted GitHub Enterprise Server instance for cloud sessions, code review, and plugin marketplaces.

skills.label: Code Review
skills.desc: Catch bugs in GitHub pull requests with Code Review: Claude reviews each change, verifies its findings, and comments inline. For Team and Enterprise plans

skills.label: Code Review costs and usage
skills.desc: Estimate and cap what your organization spends on Claude Code Review: how reviews are billed through usage credits, what drives cost, and where to track usage.

skills.label: Customize Code Review
skills.desc: Tune what Code Review flags on your pull requests with REVIEW.md and CLAUDE.md: recalibrate severity, skip paths, add checks, and see which copy applies.

skills.label: Find bugs with ultrareview
skills.desc: Run a deep, multi-agent code review in the cloud with /code-review ultra to find and verify bugs before you merge.

skills.label: Read and request reviews on a pull request
skills.desc: Read Code Review findings on your GitHub pull request, respond to or dismiss them, and request a review with @claude review.

skills.label: Review locally with /code-review
skills.desc: Run /code-review in a Claude Code session to find bugs in your branch's changes, point the review at a pull request or path, and have Claude apply the fixes.

skills.label: Scan your codebase for vulnerabilities
skills.desc: Install the Claude Security plugin to scan your codebase for vulnerabilities in a Claude Code session and turn findings into patches you review and apply.

skills.label: Set up Code Review
skills.desc: Turn on Code Review for your Claude organization: connect GitHub, install the Claude GitHub App, choose repositories, and set when reviews run

skills.label: Troubleshoot Code Review
skills.desc: Fix a Code Review that didn't start, failed, or was skipped for budget, find missing findings, and resolve setup and REVIEW.md problems.

skills.label: Explore the .claude directory
skills.desc: Where Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md, settings.json, hooks, skills, commands, subagents, workflows, rules, and auto memory. Explore the .claude directory in your project and ~/.claude in your home directory.

skills.label: Explore the context window
skills.desc: An interactive simulation of how Claude Code's context window fills during a session. See what loads automatically, what each file read costs, and when rules and hooks fire.

skills.label: Extend Claude Code
skills.desc: Understand when to use CLAUDE.md, Skills, subagents, hooks, MCP, and plugins.

skills.label: How Claude Code uses prompt caching
skills.desc: See why a model switch triggers a slow uncached turn in Claude Code, what /compact costs, and how to check your prompt cache hit rate.

skills.label: How Claude Code works
skills.desc: Understand the agentic loop, built-in tools, and how Claude Code interacts with your project.

skills.label: Claude Code changelog
skills.desc: Release notes for Claude Code, including new features, improvements, and bug fixes by version.

skills.label: Overview
skills.desc: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that reads your codebase, edits files, runs commands, and integrates with your development tools. Available in your terminal, IDE, desktop app, and browser.

skills.label: Quickstart
skills.desc: Install Claude Code in your terminal, sign in, and use the CLI to explore your codebase and make your first code change.

skills.label: Claude Code in Slack
skills.desc: What to use in place of the earlier Claude Code in Slack, on Team, Enterprise, Pro, Max, and Ultra plans.

skills.label: Claude Code on mobile
skills.desc: Start, monitor, and steer Claude Code tasks from your phone with the Claude app for iOS and Android.

skills.label: Claude Tag
skills.desc: Bring Claude into your team's Slack channels with Claude Tag and find its setup and usage documentation on claude.com.

skills.label: Continue local sessions from any device with Remote Control
skills.desc: Continue a local Claude Code session from your phone, tablet, or any browser using Remote Control. Works with claude.ai/code and the Claude mobile app.

skills.label: JetBrains IDEs
skills.desc: Use Claude Code with JetBrains IDEs including IntelliJ, PyCharm, WebStorm, and more

skills.label: Let Claude coordinate ongoing work with Projects
skills.desc: Hand Claude a stream of related tasks in one conversation and let it run them as parallel cloud sessions that share repositories, instructions, and memory.

skills.label: Let Claude use your computer from the CLI
skills.desc: Enable computer use in the Claude Code CLI so Claude can open apps, click, type, and see your screen on macOS. Test native apps, debug visual issues, and automate GUI-only tools without leaving your terminal.

skills.label: Platforms and integrations
skills.desc: Choose where to run Claude Code and what to connect it to. Compare the CLI, Desktop, VS Code, JetBrains, web, mobile, and integrations like Chrome, Slack, and CI/CD.

skills.label: Use Claude Code in VS Code
skills.desc: Install and configure the Claude Code extension for VS Code. Get AI coding assistance with inline diffs, @-mentions, plan review, and keyboard shortcuts.

skills.label: Use Claude Code with Chrome
skills.desc: Connect Claude Code to your Chrome browser to test web apps, debug with console logs, automate form filling, and extract data from web pages.

skills.label: Claude Code GitHub Actions
skills.desc: Run Claude Code in GitHub Actions workflows to respond to @claude mentions, automate tasks, and turn issues into pull requests

skills.label: Claude Code GitLab CI/CD
skills.desc: Learn about integrating Claude Code into your development workflow with GitLab CI/CD

skills.label: Use Claude Code GitHub Actions with cloud providers
skills.desc: Run Claude Code GitHub Actions through Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, or Microsoft Foundry instead of the Claude API

skills.label: Best practices for Claude Code
skills.desc: Get more out of Claude Code: tell Claude what it can't see, give it a check to run, and enforce the rules that can't have exceptions.

skills.label: Common workflows
skills.desc: Step-by-step guides for exploring codebases, fixing bugs, refactoring, testing, and other everyday tasks with Claude Code.

skills.label: How Claude remembers your project
skills.desc: Give Claude persistent instructions with CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md files, and let Claude accumulate learnings automatically with auto memory.

skills.label: Manage sessions
skills.desc: Name, resume, branch, and switch between Claude Code conversations. Covers --continue, --resume, --from-pr, the /resume picker, session naming, exporting transcripts, and where transcripts are stored.

skills.label: Prompt library
skills.desc: Copy-paste prompts for Claude Code, tagged by task and role.
